title: How Alexandria funerals compare to New Orleans
summary: Alexandria funerals lack the long second line but have ragtime and dirges played by a few readers.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. What was it like when they played funerals in Alexandria? Did they have them like the New Orleans funerals?
Oh, they, they, they, they, they people turn out like that, but they don't go as far as the people in New Orleans. They don't have a second line? Not that, not as far as the, they go peace and stop.
Do they play any ragtime on the way back? Back, they do.

They do. Do they play the real funeral marches up there? Ma'am. The funeral marches. They do. They play. They have the dodges and everything, do they read them? What, do they read music? Yeah, in Alexandria, can they read those dirges and marches? Oh yeah.
They got some moves, some good musicians there, but they're very few. Very few. That looks like about the end of it.
